question: Should autoreview inherit the operator's complete Codex user configuration, or remain isolated and receive only explicit model/provider overrides?
rationale: The removed flag governs the broader Codex configuration loader, so this changes review reproducibility and executable integration boundaries rather than merely choosing a model.

options.title: Keep autoreview isolated
options.body: Restore `--ignore-user-config` and pass supported model/provider choices through narrow explicit arguments or a dedicated isolated profile.

options.title: Approve user-config inheritance
options.body: Keep the removal only after explicitly accepting the broader execution behavior and adding coverage for user-configured integrations.

options.title: Split the workflow change
options.body: Remove this unrelated hunk and propose it through the canonical autoreview workflow source with focused review and proof.

recommendation.title: Keep autoreview isolated
recommendation.body: Restore `--ignore-user-config` and pass supported model/provider choices through narrow explicit arguments or a dedicated isolated profile.
